post.caption: Olympic gold medals are mostly silver. The rules require silver that is at least 92.5 percent pure, and the gold medal is gilded with at least six grams of gold. The last solid gold medals were awarded in Stockholm in 1912. A Paris 2024 gold medal weighs about 529 grams, and each one holds a hexagon of iron from the Eiffel Tower. Jeweler Chaumet designed them, and the Paris Mint struck them. Tokyo's 2020 medals were made from recycled phones and other electronics, and Japan collected more than six million old phones for them. Gold medals from Tokyo and Paris are both 85 millimeters wide.
